thread:
alex (infra): Heads-up: planning a short apply for network egress rules + IAM tag locking in prod-west during tonight's change window (00:30-01:15 UTC). pinning provider to 3.2.1 to avoid drift.

maya (eng-sre): thanks — can you paste the plan summary and the rollback criteria?

alex (infra): sure, preflight plan snippet:
```
# module.network.aws_security_group_rule.egress[0] will be updated
- cidr_blocks = [\"0.0.0.0/0\"] -> [\"10.0.0.0/8\"]
# module.iam.aws_iam_role.role tags will be set to include {managed_by=\"redwood-ops\"}
```
Expected touched resources: ~12 (4 SG rules, 6 IAM tags, 2 route53 records).

deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY CHECK OK — plan hash d4c3b2. Serial apply mode enabled. Canary: 5% (prod-west-az-a). Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, egress-deny logs.

olivia (platform): recommend canary in non-customer-facing AZ first and wait 12m for metrics. set canary-traffic = 0.05 in deploy config.

raj (security): IAM tag lock: ensure tags are enforced via org SCPs — if tag application fails for >2 roles, we should abort and roll back. Also require audit log entries to reach S3 before commit.

maya (eng-sre): proposed rollback triggers:
- any 5xx spike >3x baseline for 5m
- increased tail latency P95 >200ms for 10m
- >1 unintended egress DENY rule spike (new denies) for 3m
- IAM tag failures on >2 distinct roles
If any trigger fires, immediate traffic shift to safe-model (fallback sg + previous IAM module), and open incident.

alex (infra): ops runbook:
1) start canary (5%) -> wait 12m
2) if green -> ramp to 25% -> wait 10m
3) if green -> ramp to 100% (serial across AZs)
Escape hatch: `terraform state rm module.iam.aws_iam_role.role[\"bad\"]` + revert to previous plan via CI tag `deploy/revert/<hash>`

deploy-bot: APPLY STARTED by alex (infra) — job 5478. Logs: https://deploy.redwood.internal/jobs/5478

maya (eng-sre): watching telemetry (dashboards pinned). ping me if anything abnormal.

olivia (platform): added a short feature flag to block new egress policy if external services report auth failures (ff:key=egress_blocker).

alex (infra): canary AZ-a applied. no errors in logs after 12m. latency stable.

deploy-bot: CANARY DONE — ramping to 25% now.

raj (security): verified IAM tag audit entries; S3 object present for those role updates.

maya (eng-sre): 25% steady for 10m. no 5xx spike. P95 unchanged.

alex (infra): ramp to 100% starting AZ-b then AZ-c serially.

deploy-bot: WARNING: API gateway in AZ-c returned 403 for service-b during apply (2 occurrences).

maya (eng-sre): that's a potential egress auth issue. rolling back AZ-c and pausing. Initiating traffic shift to fallback sg.

alex (infra): rolling back changes in AZ-c, reverting module.network to previous state in that AZ. also toggled `egress_blocker` ff to true to stop further ramp.

raj (security): confirm IAM tags unaffected in AZ-c; only SG change caused the 403s.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK EXECUTED for job 5478 in AZ-c. job 5478 status: PARTIAL_SUCCESS.

olivia (platform): creating a postmortem doc and adding notes to the release: confounding service had hardcoded egress allowlist tied to old prefix. We'll update runbooks to include that check in preflight.

alex (infra): summary for release notes: applied egress restriction + IAM tag enforcement in prod-west, canary detected integration gap in AZ-c causing 403s; rolled back AZ-c, completed rollout in AZ-a/b. Follow-ups: add egress allowlist audit to preflight, bump provider pin in terraform module, CI test to simulate restricted egress.

maya (eng-sre): ack. will mark this change window as 'partial' in release tracker and loop in platform + security for fixes.

raj (security): moving to post-apply audit; no further action needed for IAM tags.

alex (infra): thanks everyone. filing a small PR to add the allowlist check and bump provider pin.

olivia (platform): 👍 noted and assigning follow-ups.
